headline: Boston University falls at Wake Forest
dek: After winning at Army West Point and at Navy to extend the schedule, Boston University closed the conference's season with eleven wins against nine defeats. Its attack produced 38 goals across the year, while conceding 35 before Wake Forest ended the run.
displaced_by: Boston University lost at Wake Forest to close the season, and the previous dek misstated Army West Point's final match
